title: Remote viewing God as a target

tellings.quote: >> And when I came out of the session and they opened the envelope, it said, "God."

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant who worked in a 1980s military remote viewing unit, where people tried to perceive hidden targets with the mind alone, says he was once given a target sealed in an envelope. He says that when he finished his session and the envelope was opened, the target written inside was "God," a story that, if true, suggests the unit aimed its methods even at the divine.
